g.text: Q34 · Fixed-neighborhood uncertainty curves, frozen LM (K=80)
256 paired starts / problem; shaded band: pointwise Wilson 95% interval. Triangles mark zero counts, not positive estimates.
Gray region is used to diagnose a numerical floor. Raw slopes are descriptive, not certified fractal dimensions.
